instances.claim: This tells me that the value of each Cent is never fixed but kept in continual redefinition.
instances.why: Line 16 already closes the five-transformation list with "continually redefined by decentralized consensus"; 17 then generalises that same clause ("indeterminate and continually redefined") and 18 says it a third time with the artist as subject ("an ongoing process of redefinition"), sharing the root "redefin-" each time. None of the three adds a new register — the mechanism is demonstrated by 11–16 and the form/participant register is covered by 20 — so 17 and 18 are the same point in fresh wording. Keep 18, which at least carries agency into line 19–20; cut 17.
